gen-megrim-gf-yaldevi: Sharp, techy, almost wiry: Megrim draws flat, contrast-free letters that look like they were cut from a single bent wire. Yaldevi's oversized lowercase wants a bit more size than usual.
gen-vast-shadow-fs-epilogue: Vintage swagger with a tall mean line: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width and gives each letter space to breathe. Epilogue follows with curvy, wire-thin lowercase.
gen-vast-shadow-fs-public-sans: Vintage and eye-catching, Vast Shadow looks sketched with a pencil that never presses harder. Public Sans sits beneath it with a hefty lowercase and broad, open counters, so the page gets one loud voice and one sturdy one.
gen-vast-shadow-general-sans: General Sans keeps its pen pressure steady. Beneath Vast Shadow's vintage, one-width capitals, its tall x-height fills each line and smooth curves let a long passage glide along without a snag.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-cascadia-mono: Vast Shadow brings vintage, eye-catching letters with a tall mean line and generous space around each one. Cascadia Mono stands below like pins in a wide board, compact and modern, with curves as thick as its stems.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One reads light and open, with capitals and lowercase nearly level. Vast Shadow above it brings vintage punch in single-width strokes, while the sans-serif below lets big gaps between letters hold the quiet.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-exa: Professional, yet easygoing, Lexend Exa has a big x-height and stubby ascenders. Vast Shadow can take the heading role at a generous size, while this body text probably looks best a touch smaller.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-giga: Modern and flat, Lexend Giga draws single-weight lines with generous tracking that opens up each word. Vast Shadow is the one for vintage, eye-catching display, while the sans does the quiet job of carrying text.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with one nib, its body height nearly matching its capitals and every c showing a visible gap. And beside Vast Shadow's vintage heading, a slightly smaller size for this text would feel natural.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-peta: Retro lettering with real presence: Vast Shadow cuts each stroke to one width and leaves a tall mean line overhead. Lexend Peta follows with thinning-free curves, wide-mouthed c shapes and a big x-height in a plain sans.
